facts.business: BlackBuck Limited is India's largest integrated digital platform for truck operators, offering payments, telematics, loads, and vehicle financing to simplify operations and improve earnings for ~1.1 million truck operators transacting on the platform in FY26.

segments.name: Core Businesses (Tolling, Fuel Cards, SuperLoads, Loads Classifieds, Vehicle Tracking, AIS-GPS, Vehicle Financing, Fuel Sensor)

key_risks: Revenue recognition related to income from truck operators and related services identified as key audit matter
Credit risk on security deposits paid to customers
Expected credit losses on trade receivables and other financial assets
Regulatory changes from new Labour Codes impacting employee benefit obligations
